reason: The first TRAIN/DEV implementation used the DEV median of price_updates_60 as the activity split. The median was zero, so every retained row satisfied >= median and the activity-tail-removed subset was empty for all 126 screens. This did not implement the preregistered gate 'effect not concentrated exclusively in highest-activity tail'.

first_pass.defect: low_activity_mean_improvement was NaN because the median cutoff equaled zero and all rows were assigned to the >= median subset.

correction.activity_cutoff: max(1.0, TRAIN 90th percentile of price_updates_60), computed independently inside each target/feature support frame
correction.gate: tail_removed_subset mean loss improvement must be finite and > 0; positivity inside the removed highest-activity tail is descriptive, not required
correction.freshness_gate: fresh-snapshot subset mean loss improvement must be finite and > 0
correction.capture_control: provisional promotions must also remain positive with p<=0.10, bootstrap lower>0, and leave-market minimum>0 after adding price_change_age_s, price_updates_60, and snapshot_age_s to the baseline
